 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra And Another
 ...
 Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Bilolikar Upendra Bapurao
 App for Respondents: Mr. G.A. Kulkarni
 ...
 Coram : Mangesh S. Patil &
 Shailesh P. Brahme, Jj.

Date : 15.04.2024
Per Court:
This is an application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

The husband of respondent No.2, his father and his other relatives are seeking quashment of the crime registered at her instance being Crime No.106/2023 registered with Police Station Naigaon Tq. Naigaon (Kh.) for the offences punishable under Section 498A, 323, 504 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. We have heard the learned advocate extensively.

Considering the allegations about the applicants having subjected respondent No.2 to cruelty inter alia on account of demand for money, since applicant Nos.1 and 2 being the husband and father-in-law who in all probability must have been cohabiting with respondent No.2 under 31.APPLN.1578.24.odt the same roof, we are not inclined to entertain their request for quashment of the crime.
3. The application to the extent of applicant Nos.1 and 2 is rejected.
